english.title: Leave premises in pig surveillance zone without cleansing and disinfecting vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in charge of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..), which was in a surveillance zone declared following confirmation of disease in domestic pigs, namely **(..SPECIFY ZONE..), and

(A)_[was used to transport pigs within the surveillance zone,]_
(B)_[was used to transport livestock or material which may have been contaminated with disease,]_
(C)_[which may have been contaminated with disease,]_

left **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), the premises of destination, without having thoroughly cleansed and disinfected the vehicle and any equipment in it so as to minimise the risk of spread of disease
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 4 to and regulation 39(1)(t) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
